name: maple_oak
comment: maple forest carrier - the actual placement uses the vanilla minecraft:oak / birch / fancy_oak configured features via the feature-trees placement in config.yml (dense, water-safe, as dense as forest body). The maple_forest_NN biomes recolor the foliage to the warm autumn palette, so vanilla oak/birch read as maple. This baked definition is only the jigsaw carrier and a fallback shape.
